project_identity.name: A Paso Ligero
project_identity.subtitle: Archivo Histórico de Música Militar Española
project_identity.tagline: Web de Músicas Militares - Preservando el patrimonio musical de las Fuerzas Armadas
project_identity.author: Álvar Barrios Martínez
project_identity.vibe: Dark Tactical Editorial, Precision Engineering meets Military Heritage Archive

archetype_and_theme.palette_strategy: Scorched Obsidian (#070907) as primary depth, Deep Olive Drab (#0E130E & #141B14) for surfaces, Brass Gold (#D4A359) and Signal Red (#E53935) for tactical triggers, Crisp White (#F4F5F4) for high-legibility editorial content.
archetype_and_theme.border_philosophy: Tactical 1px sharp borders with low-opacity olive/brass (#2A342A / #D4A35933). Zero drop shadows; depth created purely through tonal layering and hair-line grids.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight
hierarchy.label_tactical: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-amber-400/90 font-medium

rules: Headings MUST use Barlow Condensed or Oswald with uppercase transformation for a military editorial look.
Overlines, categories, badge labels MUST use JetBrains Mono uppercase with explicit wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Body text MUST remain DM Sans or Inter with maximum 65ch width for reading comfort.
NEVER use raw un-styled Inter for main section headings.

colors.gradient_policy: STRICT NO GRADIENT OVERLOAD. Surfaces must be solid dark olive/obsidian. Gradients are permitted ONLY as subtle linear 1px hairline glowing borders or dark radial vignette spotlights.

textures: Tactical crosshair reticles (+) on card corners
Military stencil chevrons and section index numbers (e.g. SEC_01 // PASO LIGERO)
Scanline repeating SVG background for high-tech archive hero modules
patterns: Dot Matrix grid for audio player spectrum backdrop
ui_motifs: Corner brackets on active cards (`border-t-2 border-l-2 border-amber-400`)
LED status indicator dots (pulse green for playing audio, amber for archive read)
Military dossier badge stamps ('REGISTRO MILITAR ESPAÑOL', 'AUDIO MASTER HQ')

grids_and_layout.hero_layout: Bento Tetris Grid: 12-column high-tension layout with left dominant headline + audio preview card + stats ticker + branch shortcut tiles.
grids_and_layout.catalog_layout: Strict 3-column / 4-column tactical cards for Himnos & Toques, with sticky sidebar filtering by Military Branch (Ejército de Tierra, Armada, Aire, Guardia Civil, UME, etc.).
grids_and_layout.lyric_detail_layout: Split-screen Dossier view: Left sticky column with Audio Player, Branch Emblem, Historic Notes & Download CTA; Right scrolling column with formatted lyrics in high-contrast editorial typography.
grids_and_layout.gap_scale: gap-4 for dense data grids, gap-8 to gap-12 for section boundaries.

navigation_header.style: Sticky Crystal Tactical Nav bar with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#070907]/90 border-b border-[#1D261D])
contents: Brand Logo: Corneta / Chevron Monogram SVG with 'A PASO LIGERO'
CTA Button: '¡Aporten!' / Colaborar button with tactical hover glow
Global Audio Status Indicator Pill (showing current playing track if active)

hero_section.headline: A PASO LIGERO
hero_section.subheadline: PATRIMONIO DE MÚSICAS Y HIMNOS MILITARES DE ESPAÑA
hero_section.description: Archivo histórico documentado por Álvar Barrios Martínez. Partituras sonoras, marchas de infantería, toques de corneta y lemas de las Fuerzas Armadas.
features: Lemas Históricos en Latín y Español

audio_player_system.type: Global Persistent Audio Player Bar at bottom + Inline audio player buttons on cards
features: Play / Pause / Progress slider / Time readout / Volume control / Download MP3
Current track metadata display with unit badge emblem

toques_corneta_list.style: Interactive tactical list with instant inline audio preview, status badge, description of when the call is played, and audio download button.

lemas_unit_grid.style: Dossier cards showing Unit Name, Branch Badge, Latin Motto in bold gold display font, Spanish translation, and historical context.

guestbook_and_contact.style: Tactical Transmission Form with input fields (Nombre, Email, Unidad/Afiliación, Mensaje), military stamp style submit button, and author bio section.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration for fluid editorial reading.
hover_effects: Cards: 1px amber glow outline + 2px translate up
Buttons: Sharp color inversion from dark olive with amber text to gold fill with black text
Links: Animated tactical underline reveal (left to right)
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered Framer Motion slide-up (`y: 20 -> 0`, `opacity: 0 -> 1`) with duration 0.4s and easeOut.

accessibility_and_contrast.contrast_ratios: Minimum 5:1 for standard body text over #070907, 7:1 for headings.
accessibility_and_contrast.focus_states: ring-2 ring-amber-400 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#070907] on all interactives.
accessibility_and_contrast.test_ids: Mandatory data-testid on every interactive button, input, link, tab, player control, and item card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this design_guidelines.json completely before modifying any code.
Maintain all Spanish content, song titles, lyrics, author info, and military category classifications without loss.
Implement the React frontend in src/ with structured components using standard .js / .jsx extensions.
Use Tailwind CSS with custom color extensions matching this document (dark tactical greens, scorched obsidian, amber brass).
Ensure every interactive element has a unique `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-toques', data-testid='audio-play-button-1').
Build a persistent audio player bar that plays tracks seamlessly while navigating between archive pages or filtering.
Add search and filter functionality for Himnos, Toques de Corneta, and Lemas to make the vast archive instantly accessible.

anti_ai_slop_rules: DO NOT center-align main paragraph texts or body layout containers; maintain disciplined editorial left alignment.
DO NOT use generic rounded blue cards or standard Vercel dark mode templates.
Use sharp or minimal border radius (rounded-none or rounded-sm) for a crisp tactical tool aesthetic.
Incorporate micro-animations on hover, active states, and page transitions.
Ensure text contrast adheres to APCA standards with strong visibility on dark tactical surfaces.
